distribution: Jianou, Yongan, Changting and Nanjing, Fujian; Jiangxi; Pingyuan, Dabu and Xingning, Guangdong; Guangxi; Chongqing; Nanxi and Changpotou, Jinping, Yunnan, 1100 m above sea level.
soldier: Head yellow, nasus reddish with a little brown mixed in, thorax and abdomen pale yellow. Head and dorsum of the abdomen with sparse fine hairs and scattered long hairs, the hairs of the ventral surface of the abdomen denser. Head longer than wide, narrower at the anterior third, gradually widening posteriorly, widest near the posterior end; the posterior margin slightly concave in the middle; nasus slightly longer than half the length of the head, projecting forwards in profile, the base of the nasus swollen and raised; mandibles without a spine, but the anterolateral angle rather sharp; antennae with 13 segments, the relative lengths of the third and fourth segments variable. Anterior part of the pronotum erect, meeting the posterior part at a right angle; abdomen slender olive-shaped. Small soldier: head yellowish brown, the frons slightly paler, the base of the nasus pale, antennae pale yellow, meso- and metanotal plates and legs brownish yellow; head pear-shaped and rather broad, widest posteriorly; nasus tubular, slightly upturned in profile; the apical tooth of the mandible mostly inconspicuous; antennae with 13 segments, occasionally 14, in the 13-segmented condition the fourth shortest; anterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave in the middle, the posterior margin shallowly arcuately concave in the middle; abdomen olive-shaped.
taxonomy_note: The genus name in the original work is spelt Ahntaditermes; it is now assigned to the genus Ahmaditermes.
worker: Head yellow, abdomen pale yellow, the whole body densely covered with short hairs. Head between round and square, slightly expanded beside the antennal sockets; postclypeus raised, less than half as long as wide; the dorsum of the head with a pale T-shaped suture; antennae with 14 segments, the second longer than the third and fourth. Length of head to the tip of the labrum 0.92–1.33 mm, width of head 0.72–1.03 mm, width of pronotum 0.36–0.53 mm.
